title: 047 - Validation Summary
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print username,password when both fields fail validation and prints exactly `username,password`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:

{
    $merged = [];
    $leftIndex = 0;
    $rightIndex = 0;
    while ($leftIndex < count($left) && $rightIndex < count($right)) {

solutionCode:
<?php

function validationSummary(array $left, array $right): string
{
    $merged = [];
    $leftIndex = 0;
    $rightIndex = 0;
    while ($leftIndex < count($left) && $rightIndex < count($right)) {
        if ($left[$leftIndex] <= $right[$rightIndex]) {
            $merged[] = $left[$leftIndex];
            $leftIndex += 1;
        } else {
            $merged[] = $right[$rightIndex];
            $rightIndex += 1;
        }
    }
    return implode(",", array_merge($merged, array_slice($left, $leftIndex), array_slice($right, $rightIndex)));
}
hint: Both failures should appear in the summary.
explanation: The broken code stops after the first failing rule. Collecting every failing field fixes the summary.
